records.claim: Express Entry manages applications for the Canadian Experience Class, Federal Skilled Worker Program and Federal Skilled Trades Program, each with distinct language, work-experience and job-offer rules.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Government of Canada Express Entry eligibility guidance

records.claim: Study permit applicants must demonstrate sufficient funds for tuition, living expenses and transportation, with the applicable living-expense amount depending on family size and application date.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Government of Canada financial-support guidance

records.claim: Applicants from outside the EU/EEA who want to study in Norway generally need a residence permit for studies; the permit covers university, university college, vocational and certain other qualifying study programmes.
records.methodology: Direct review of current UDI study-permit guidance

records.claim: For covered Norwegian work-residence applications submitted by the applicant from abroad, the employer or client may need to confirm the job or assignment offer to UDI and provide a confirmation code for the application.
records.methodology: Direct review of current UDI fraud-prevention/job-offer confirmation guidance

records.claim: Portugal's remote-work residence authorisation requires a valid passport, the applicable remote-work residence visa, a declaration confirming the employment or service relationship with a person or entity outside Portugal, and proof of the residence address under the applicable rules.
records.methodology: Direct review of current AIMA remote-work residence guidance

records.claim: AIMA currently lists a dedicated residence authorisation route for remote professional activity performed for entities outside Portugal and identifies the relevant residence-visa framework under Article 88(1).
records.methodology: Direct review of current AIMA working-routes index

records.claim: Japan's residence-status framework includes Student (留学) for qualifying education at universities, colleges, vocational schools and other listed educational institutions, subject to the applicable immigration rules.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Immigration Services Agency status-of-residence table

records.claim: Japan's residence-status framework includes Engineer/Specialist in Humanities/International Services for qualifying activities requiring technical or humanities knowledge or foreign-cultural expertise under a contract with a Japanese public or private organisation, subject to the applicable rules.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Immigration Services Agency status-of-residence table
